svg.text: Private Endpoint /32 Route Override, Firewall Inspection & Symmetry
PE NIC ignores its own subnet UDR on return!
Without SNAT, SYN-ACK bypasses Hub FW.
Fix: AzFW App Rules (auto-SNAT) or explicit SNAT.
Option B: Virtual WAN Routing Intent
Secured vHub Private Routing Intent steers
Zero SNAT on Network Rules (App Rules proxy).
Suppresses /32 system route & evaluates NSG + ASG
Receives FW-inspected flow; returns SYN-ACK to
FW SNAT IP (Option A) or vHub Router (Option B)
